signal: Rasa unveiled multimodal voice AI for enterprises at Customer Contact Week in June 2025 and is building agents with its CALM approach in 2026

email.body1:
Will, saw Rasa unveiled multimodal voice AI for enterprises and is now building agents with your CALM approach.

New product lines like that usually open more in-market accounts than business development can personally touch before the category moment fades. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Rasa off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Will, quick follow-up for Rasa.

With voice AI and CALM-built agents in market, demand often outpaces what global BD can cover. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to capitalize on it, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Rasa needs across regions, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Will, last bit of proof for Rasa.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Rasa's reply rate likely compares to other conversational AI teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Will, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while voice AI ramps, no problem at all. Timing is everything around launches, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a global BD motion? I'll tailor it to Rasa either way.
